title: 1914 French Grand Prix
lead: The 1914 French Grand Prix was a Grand Prix motor race held at Lyon on 4 July 1914. title: New Year Sprint
lead: The New Year Sprint (formerly known as the Powderhall Sprint ) is a handicap sprint race for professional and amateur athletes that takes place each year in Edinburgh, Scotland. lead: Imbolc or Imbolg ( Irish pronunciation: [ ə ˈmˠɔlˠəɡ ] ), also called Saint Brigid's Day ( Irish : Lá Fhéile Bríde ; Scottish Gaelic : Là Fhèill Brìghde ; Manx : Laa'l Breeshey ), is a Gaelic traditional festival on 1 February. title: Govardhan Puja
lead: Govardhan Puja ( IAST : Govardhana-pūjā ) or Annakut (meaning a “mountain of food”), is a Hindu festival celebrated on the first lunar day of the bright fortnight of the month of Kartika, on the fourth day of Diwali. Devotees worship an image of Govardhan Hill made out of cow dung and prepare and offer a large variety of vegetarian food to Krishna as a mark of gratitude.
